partialText: <p>Building a live-tracking marketplace like Fixaro requires a deep understanding of scalable architecture, real-time updates, and seamless user experience. In this article, we'll dive into the technical decisions and lessons learned from building Fixaro's platform using Next.js and React Native. Disclosure: I work with Adrologic, the studio behind Fixaro's development. We'll cover topics such as optimizing database queries, implementing WebSockets for real-time updates, and ensuring a smooth user experience across web and mobile platforms. By sharing our experiences and insights, we hope to provide valuable guidance for developers and businesses looking to build similar platforms. Check out the full case study on our website: adrologic.com</p>
